metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates a simple, effective exercise to quickly relieve sinus pressure and nasal congestion.

This gentle technique can be done while lying in bed and may help clear a stuffy nose in as little as 30 seconds—perfect for those restless nights when congestion keeps you from sleeping.

Let us know how well it works for you!
